scope: Representative real-image trials and separate instruction/code checks; no claim that every option combination was rendered or will always match.

actualTrials.method: single-stage image generation with unchanged application prompt
observed: mountains and lake with foreground, middle distance and background
no people, text or unsolicited magic

actualTrials.method: two one-pass generation attempts with detailed complete prompts
observed: photographic face and paint instead of clear 2D planes
missing or weak projected hologram structure
unsafe subject cropping; first attempt also had three body columns
whole pose and hologram membranes improved
face and hair rendering still too photographic

actualTrials.method: focused style repair using only the generated artwork
observed: clearer facial outlines, planar color and cel shadows on face/body/wrapping
visible projection membranes and scan lines
frontal face and crossed-leg pose retained
limits: likeness and style still require human review

observed: artwork was reframed and cropped despite explicit contain instructions

actualTrials.method: actual application import, native SVG document composition and browser PNG export
observed: one original bitmap with proportional contain placement
exact Japanese copy in two body frames
no clipping, text overlap or gutter collision observed

browserChecks: native preview and actual PNG download
referencePolicy: Only the creator-supplied character reference and the generated intermediate artwork were used for artistic image calls. Option thumbnails and real magazine photographs were not supplied.
reproduction: scripts/image-proof-cases.mjs reproduces current application inputs. Staged artwork and style-repair inputs are identical for portrait and wide spread cases; their final canvas selection differs.
